## Accepted

### Causal Story-Guided Agentic Causal Discovery with Small Language Models

**Brandon Mossop** and Salimur Choudhury.  
Accepted to the **4th International Conference on Foundation and Large Language Models (FLLM 2026)**.

This work extends agentic causal discovery with explicit causal-story reasoning and evaluates the approach on engineering datasets.

## 2026

### Regime-aware causal Bayesian forecasting for non-stationary time series

**Brandon Mossop** and Salimur Choudhury.  
*PLOS ONE*, 21(8), e0356474, 2026.

A regime-aware forecasting framework that combines temporal causal discovery, Bayesian structural models, predictive regime classification, and posterior predictive uncertainty.

[Read the paper →](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0356474){.pub-link target="_blank"}  
[Code →](https://github.com/bdmossop/CaReBayes){.pub-link target="_blank"}

### Improving machine learning forecasting explainability and performance with causal feature selection for infectious disease spread

**Brandon Mossop** and Salimur Choudhury.  
*INFOR: Information Systems and Operational Research*, 2026.

This work investigates causal feature selection for infectious-disease forecasting, with emphasis on interpretability and predictive performance.

[Read the paper →](https://doi.org/10.1080/03155986.2026.2719323){.pub-link target="_blank"}

## 2025

### Agent-guided Causal Discovery with a Small Language Model

**Brandon Mossop** and Salimur Choudhury.  
*2025 3rd International Conference on Foundation and Large Language Models (FLLM)*, pp. 693–698, 2025.

An agent-guided causal discovery framework combining conditional-independence testing, contextual orientation, edge augmentation, and critique with a small language model.

[Read the paper →](https://doi.org/10.1109/FLLM67465.2025.11391103){.pub-link target="_blank"}
